articles.summary: Honda Global | Honda Motor Co., Ltd. hereby announces the personnel changes as outlined below.
articles.title: Notice Concerning Personnel Changes

articles.summary: Honda Global | Honda Racing Corporation (HRC) has reached agreement with Fabio Quartararo, the 2021 FIM Grand Prix World Championship MotoGP World Champion and current MotoGP rider, and David Alonso, who is currently competing in the FIM Grand Prix World Championship Moto2 class, to join HRC’s MotoGP program from the 2027 season.
articles.title: ＜FIM Grand Prix World Championship - MotoGP＞ HRC Reaches Agreement with Fabio Quartararo and David Alonso

articles.summary: Honda Global | Honda Motor (China) Investment Co., Ltd. (HMCI), a wholly-owned Honda subsidiary in China, today announced that Honda and its automobile production and sales joint venture partner in China, Guangzhou Automobile Group Co., Ltd. (GAC Group), signed an agreement to extend the joint venture term of GAC Honda Automobile Co., Ltd. (GAC Honda) through 2038.
articles.title: Honda Signs Agreement with GAC Group to Extend Term of GAC Honda Joint Venture

articles.summary: Honda Global | Honda Motor Co., Ltd. today announced a summary of automobile production, Japan domestic sales, and export results for the month of June 2026.
articles.title: Production, Sales and Export Results for June, 2026

articles.summary: Honda Global | Noetra Corp., along with its core member companies and investors—Sony Group Corporation, SoftBank Corp., NEC Corporation, and Honda Motor Co., Ltd.—launched full-scale R&D for a Japan-developed multimodal foundation model that will serve as the foundation for AI-enabled robots and physical AI, in collaboration with a broad range of partners engaged in the development and application of sovereign AI in Japan.
articles.title: Noetra Launches Full-Scale R&D for Japan-Developed Multimodal Foundation Model

articles.summary: Honda Global | Honda Motor de Argentina S.A. (HAR), which is responsible for the manufacturing and sales of motorcycles, as well as the sales of automobiles and power products in Argentina, has established a new company, Honda Plan Argentina (HPA).
articles.title: Honda Establishes New Subsidiary in Argentina Dedicated to Capital Management Services

articles.summary: Honda Global | Honda factory team “Honda HRC” has won the 2026 FIM Endurance World Championship “Coca-Cola” Suzuka 8 Hours Road Race 47th Annual Event (Suzuka 8 Hours) held at the Suzuka Circuit in Mie, on Sunday, July 5.
articles.title: ＜FIM Endurance World Championship＞ Honda HRC Wins the 47th Suzuka 8 Hours Endurance Road Race
